specs.title: [scenario:executor-marks] The graph shows solid worker and review nodes and dashed handoff, verify, candidate, approval and integrate nodes with a legend; each node's accessible name and detail page name its executor (worker)

[scenario:created-file-rendered] The launch node renders a captured Markdown file, shows a captured source file on demand, lists too-large and binary entries with reasons; a legacy run says files were not captured (worker)
[scenario:output-first-task-collapsed] The launch node's result and files precede the task, the task disclosure is closed, and a finding's requirement link opens it and highlights the quote (worker)
[scenario:verify-shows-checks-not-files] The verify node shows checks, gate, deferred checks and screenshots and no created-files section; the launch node shows no checks table (worker)

[scenario:findings-on-files] A captured file lists exactly the findings whose messages name its path verbatim; a path:N-M finding marks those source lines; review findings naming a captured file link to it (worker)

[scenario:findings-by-reviewer] A two-reviewer run opens grouped by reviewer in declared order with each verdict and counts; the reviewer filter composes; a single-reviewer run opens by disposition (worker)

[scenario:challenge-node-page] The graph starts with Design challenge; its page shows the status, the concerns by severity with consequences, the simpler alternative, the cheap experiment and the accepted reason (worker)
[scenario:completion-evidence-shown] The launch node shows untested, the falsifying check linked to the verify node's check, and verify-yourself; a legacy run says evidence was not recorded (worker)
[scenario:worker-questions-shown] Answered and waiting worker questions are listed with their times, and the waiting one is marked (worker)
[scenario:decisions-shown] The Assignment page renders decisions.md as Markdown; a run without it says so (worker)
[scenario:inert-markdown] Captured Markdown and decisions.md with a remote image and an external link make no network request, and the link renders as text (worker)
On a guarded graph the captured files show the independent review's findings, never a review looked up through the design challenge (worker)
[scenario:run-assignment] The Assignment tab shows what the run was asked to do, with tasks rendered as Markdown (worker)
[scenario:worker-inputs] A worker node shows its task, ownership, required checks linked to executed ones, launch receipt and completion (worker)
[scenario:finding-to-task] A verbatim requirement quote links to the worker task and is highlighted there (worker)
[scenario:inputs-legacy] A run exported before run inputs says they are not recorded, without an error (worker)
[scenario:inputs-paths-redacted] No absolute path from the seeded inputs reaches the rendered assignment or worker panels (worker)
[scenario:viewer-three-lanes] A three-lane run shows three launch and verify nodes, three workers and findings grouped by lane (worker)
[scenario:legacy-run] A stored 1.2.0 two-lane export renders as before without re-export (worker)
[scenario:projects-navigation] Pi and Claude remain usable and Projects opens registered projects (worker)
[scenario:workflow-run-graph] Select a project, workflow and run and inspect the pinned graph (worker)
[scenario:run-evidence] Inspect worker checks, changed files, assumptions, logs and screenshot evidence (worker)
[scenario:empty-states] Distinguish no workflows from no runs (worker)
[scenario:failed-and-paused] Show failure and awaiting-approval state without implying completion (worker)
[scenario:request-errors] Show an actionable API error rather than silently substituting fixtures (worker)
[scenario:candidate-evidence] The combined candidate node shows every lane's verified result with its checks and screenshots (worker)
[scenario:deferred-checks] A lane verified in isolation shows its deferred build and browser checks as gated at the combined candidate, not as failures (worker)
[scenario:live-refresh] A shown run re-reads its state in the background without a Refresh (worker)
[scenario:registry-refresh] A workflow registered while the project page is open appears without a Refresh (worker)
[scenario:review-verdict] The review node shows the verdict, reviewer, bundle, summary and findings (worker)
[scenario:review-blocked] A blocked review shows the verdict, the failed node and the findings that caused it (worker)
[scenario:review-legacy] A run exported before review results says no review is recorded, without an error (worker)
[scenario:paths-redacted] No absolute path from the seeded review reaches the rendered panel (worker)
[scenario:viewer-two-reviewers] A two-reviewer run shows both verdicts in the reviewer strip, a Reviewer column and filtering by reviewer; a legacy export shows one entry named review (worker)
[scenario:files-dense] The files are dense rows from the worker's freeze, findings first, with repair marks; nothing is fetched until a row opens, and Markdown opens on Rendered (worker)
[scenario:launch-review-late] A review recorded while the launch page is open reaches its files without a reload (worker)
[scenario:launch-report-no-signal] Without a completion signal the launch node still shows the result's own summary and assumptions (worker)
[scenario:launch-question-first] While a question waits, the Questions section comes first with both answer forms; a running worker's Session shows its state at launch (worker)
[scenario:node-header] A node opens on its status by cause, its timing and attempt, the next step on the focus, and a section index whose counts match (worker)
[scenario:node-attempts] Earlier attempts have their own pages, linked from the attempt strip once their result loads and from Activity (worker)
[scenario:review-blocking-first] A review opens on its blocking finding before the table; reviewers show their time only from served fields; phone width shows the same findings as cards (worker)
[scenario:challenge-headline] A challenge opens on one headline over its attempts, with P0/P1 open and P2 one line each; a paused one shows its P1 and the commands to resume (worker)
[scenario:controller-panels] The handoff shows its wait from the receipts, an approval with no event is ≈, the integration names branch and commit, and a manual approval shows its command (worker)
[scenario:run-now-banner] The Now banner names the situation, its cause and the RUNBOOK command to type, inside the first screen (worker)
[scenario:run-steps-timeline] Steps give each step's start, duration and attempt markers inside the first screen; Activity shows the controller's diagnosis and the repair without a click (worker)
[scenario:graph-fits] The graph fits the page width at 1280 and 1440 px, with its last step in view and the columns in order; narrower, the focus step is scrolled into view (worker)
[scenario:assignment-routed] The Assignment tab is a URL, survives a reload and keeps its keyboard pattern; the tabs sit above the graph (worker)
[scenario:narrow-run] At 390×844 the run page fits the width, starts with the Now banner, and a tapped step's heading is in view and focused (worker)
[scenario:question-attention] A waiting question or a pane that needs attention is marked on the banner, the graph, the Steps, the step strip and the tab title (worker)
[scenario:live-freshness] A live chip says whether the run is polled and how fresh it is; Refresh keeps the page in place (worker)

suites.title: in a zone west of UTC

specs.title: [scenario:time-local-utc] Times are <time> elements in the local zone, switchable to UTC and remembered; the run's day is named; check rows show durations (worker)
A run list left open past midnight re-reads which day is today (worker)

[scenario:gate-rejected-checks] The gate counts the checks it rejected, keys each reason to its check, keeps an unkeyed reason at the gate, and shows rejected checks red with their log tail open (worker)
[scenario:candidate-lanes-table] The combined candidate opens on its lanes, failing lanes first and open, passing lanes closed; screenshots open full size in a dialog (worker)
